name: @fling/edge
description: The CloudFront Functions (cloudfront-js-2.0): the site router, which routes sites hosts to S3 objects or site servers (a thin shell around the shared routing decision, @fling/shared/site-routing), and the server status function, which puts a site server's own 403 or 404 back. Bundled by build.mjs; index.mjs runs the bundles in Node for tests and local dev.
